sourceSpecificLaw.fDefinition: Dot normalized semantic ground-forward with fixed camera horizontal direction. Actual source S is front at0degrees, E+90,N180,W-90, so for this source f=cos(rootYaw). Use semantic root orientation rather than action/head tilt or discrete facing labels.
sourceSpecificLaw.sourceLawMeasurements: Existing local X/Y coefficient0.39319298125871605 and Z0.27531668543815613 correspond to about0.6world units toward the fixed35degree camera. These were measured from Omar; no other chef constants/law were read or imported.
sourceSpecificLaw.parameterSharing: One dMin world-distance value and identical function for catalog salmon and runtime cucumber, in every action/frame and continuously in root orientation. Declare units/conversion, source d0 and selected dMin in recipe.
sourceSpecificLaw.C1Derivation: For f>=0 depth is constant d0. For f<0 depth is d0-(d0-dMin)f^2 and its derivative -2(d0-dMin)f tends to0 at f=0. Values and first derivative agree at the side boundary. For this source depth at S/front and E/W sides is d0; at N/rear it is dMin.

occlusionAdjustmentPolicy.allowed: Only the food display XYZ location drivers camera-ray offset may gain a single smooth semantic-orientation law. occlusionAdjustmentPolicy.law: Let f be the dot product of normalized semantic ground-forward and the fixed camera horizontal direction. Let d0 be the actual existing camera-ray bias. d(f)=d0-(d0-dMin)*max(0,-f)^2, with 0<=dMin<=d0. Preserve the existing bias exactly for the front and side half-plane; continuously reduce it in the rear half-plane. Measure coordinate conventions from this source; do not import Rowan constants.
occlusionAdjustmentPolicy.registration: Original physical palm trajectory, root, actions, rig and semantic pose remain exact. Food display width/full canonical UV/aspect stay fixed. The 3D display offset can change only along this ray; do not claim unchanged world food-plane positions.
occlusionAdjustmentPolicy.continuity: C1 continuous at the forward/side boundary, one continuous native expression, no facing switches or discrete keys. Audit representative intermediate root angles around the transition as well as all shipping frames. Avoid driver FCurve numerical snapping; validate actual evaluated transforms and expression mapping.
